title: randia angatensis
intro: Randia angatensis, commonly known as the Philippine snake root, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family, native to the Philippines. The health benefits of Randia angatensis include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which help in reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and lowering body temperature. The bioactive constituents of Randia angatensis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential health benefits.
